recipe.notes:
The dense Gemma 4 judge (60 layers, 10 full). Client block: no temperature, NO extra_body sampling (owner answer 3; the 31B card's own benchmark line is temperature 1.0 / top_p 0.95 -- to opt in, `--set judge.temperature=1.0 --set judge.extra_body='{"top_p": 0.95, "top_k": 64}'`), max_output_tokens 16384, context_tokens 131072 (owner answer 4), concurrency 256, decoding json_schema, image_processor gemma4, max_images 10, max_videos 0. Thinking OFF by default, thinking on as a declared client choice (owner answer 2); video via `wire: frames` only (owner answer 5); audio out of scope (owner answer 8). No bf16 31B sibling ships in 0.0.1 (owner answer 6): the family carries the NVFP4 release only; a bf16 sibling would be a third variant with the 26B bf16's weight class (~62 GB, TP1 per decision 41). Licence: the Hub tag is `other` with `license_name: apache-license-2.0` and the card states Apache License 2.0 ("ready for commercial/non-commercial use"); the YAML's `other` + license_name is a spelling, not a different grant, so the recipe declares apache-2.0 (handover/specs/judge-catalog.md section 7.4.3). Quantisation: ModelOpt NVFP4 on the dense MLP only (180 quantised tensors = 60 layers x 3 projections; attention, lm_head, the vision tower and embed_vision are excluded); the checkpoint's kv_cache_scheme is 8-bit float, so `--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3` records what `auto` resolves to. The E2 wave records the chosen linear backend (owner answer 7). Memory arithmetic, both GPU classes (GiB, --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92). Weights 30.39 GiB (32 633 255 032 B on disk, 4 shards: 10 404 495 360 U8 + 10 464 098 156 BF16 parameters and 1 300 561 920 B of F8 scale tensors). KV (fp8): 10 full layers x 2 x 4 global KV heads x 512 x 1 B = 40 960 B/token at TP1 (a 32k window 1.25 GiB) + sliding 50 x 1024 x 2 x 16 x 256 x 1 B = 0.39 GiB/sequence -> a 32k window 1.64 GiB. - B200 (192 GB; 0.92 -> 164.51 GiB): 164.51 - 30.39 = 134.12 GiB cache -> ~82 concurrent 32k windows.
  resources.gpus: 1; throughput scales by replicas.
- H100 (80 GB; 0.92 -> 68.55 GiB): 68.55 - 30.39 = 38.16 GiB cache -> ~23 concurrent 32k windows. Same
  shape -- no `--set` override needed.
Engine support: Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration is in vLLM v0.31.0's registry (registry.py:418); checked at the pinned revision 2026-10-09. status: unverified until the E2 judge wave passes.

The Hub head at the check date. The served name is the recipe id; the T4 scenarios override it to their slot name at run time. B200 and H100: TP1 (resources.gpus 1).
